alt: 騎士在懸崖前拉緊韁繩，棕馬及時停下腳步。
scene_prompt: Side view of a rider on a brown horse stopping just before the edge of a steep rocky cliff. Rider leans back pulling reins; horse plants its hind legs and lifts its front hooves slightly, dust showing sudden braking. All hooves and human hands anatomically coherent, no falling, safe distance from cliff edge. Dangerous precipice clearly visible on right, path behind on left. Historical countryside setting chosen for the idiom metaphor of timely turning back.
